assignmentTitle: Design and Analysis of a Knuckle Joint for a Tractor–Trailer

criteria.title: Engineering Context & Real-World Observation
criteria.description: Understanding client brief, tractor–trailer load path, 3-ton capacity context, and project scope.

criteria.title: Tractor–Trailer Load Path Identification
criteria.description: Correct identification of the mechanical load sequence from tractor engine to trailer drawbar.

criteria.title: Knuckle Joint Component Identification
criteria.description: Accurate labeling of tractor, trailer, tractor drawbar, trailer drawbar, single eye, fork lugs, vertical pin, and retaining pin on EA-11.

criteria.title: Working Principle & Joint Articulation
criteria.description: Understanding vertical pin orientation, horizontal plan-view turning rotation, and tensile load transfer.

criteria.title: 30° Turning Condition & Resultant Load Analysis
criteria.description: Calculation of straight pulling force (29.43 kN) and resultant towing force (33.98 kN) during 30° turn.

criteria.title: Design Requirements & Engineering Assumptions
criteria.description: Formulation of valid engineering assumptions regarding material strengths, allowable stresses, and FoS.

criteria.title: Knuckle Joint Component Stress Calculations
criteria.description: Calculation of double shear stress in pin, tensile stress across single eye, and bearing crushing stress.

criteria.title: Failure Analysis & Factor of Safety Verification
criteria.description: Determination of actual Factor of Safety against allowable shear and tensile strength limits.

criteria.title: Engineering Judgement & Design Recommendation
criteria.description: Evaluation of joint safety under turning conditions, critical failure mode identification, and design improvements.

criteria.title: Final Engineering Summary Report
criteria.description: Synthesizing concise engineering summary report with recommendations for assembly, lubrication, and field maintenance.
